dependency: The <=15% proposal gate is defined against W1 projected flat target; W1 is measured blocked and that denominator is unattainable in this campaign state.
policy_risk: Hot-vocabulary/truncated-head proposal changes are T3 and can reduce acceptance; full suite plus heldouts would be required. The mechanism cannot cover the wall even at zero proposal cost.
decision: Close W4 measured-blocked. Do not implement hot-vocabulary or fused top-1 policy: completely free proposal saves only 32.8%/24.1% of the C6/C8 wall gap, and the optimizable excess is 0.85/0.44 s.
